basis: Opened current official model documentation, local model-selection skill, exact 27 adoption units and independent task-fit assessment; Can-specific allocations are judgment, not provider task benchmarks.

sources.supports: model roles and starting-point/representative comparison guidance
Sol role and public API supported reasoning settings
Luna role and public API supported reasoning settings
Astra role and public API supported reasoning settings

units.label: P01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Inventory extraction is routine; interpreting source-ready versus installed evidence is technical. Raise to Sol high only for conflicting credited evidence.

units.label: P02
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Transcribe aliases cheaply; reconcile original DAG, scope, HOLD and sole writers with technical judgment.

units.label: N01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Design independent IEEE-754, negative-zero, JSON nonfinite and Rust-str/UTF-16 oracles. Prepared seeded fixtures can be cheaper.

units.label: N02
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Small formatter adapter under a frozen oracle; check real diagnostic callers. Escalate for unexpected carrier or envelope conflict.

units.label: N03
units.rationale_and_decomposition: The full unit includes four decisions and actual harness/registration reconciliation. A released leaf formatter alone fits Sol medium.

units.label: N04
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Existing serde_json and a frozen Rust-str signature bound the mechanics. Error callers and the separate UTF-16 truncation residual require review.

units.label: N05
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Values/validation domain routing, ABI/glue, registration and assets span owners. An already specified individual consumer check can use Sol medium.

units.label: N06
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Actual Cargo decision assembly and durable/installed consumers must replace source-only and TS-only evidence.

units.label: D01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Freeze sync initialization, first-fault behavior, host closure, malformed admission, mutable cache and verbatim source identities.

units.label: D02
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Decoded literals versus UTF-16 spans, import forms, whole-file failures and edit maps affect bundle/modules integration. A frozen pure adapter subpacket may use Sol medium.

units.label: D03
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Preserve lookup bias, unmapped and malformed segments, duplicates/order, names, raw identities and mutable-map cache despite library defaults.

units.label: D04
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Map composition and invoke fallback must preserve compiled identity across actual Node/workerd and installed diagnostics. Independent critical review is a short separate packet.

units.label: D05
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Design-only parser-seam comparison remains held for implementation. Astra medium only for a consequential unresolved architecture decision after evidence/JEV.

units.label: I01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Persisted password/token encoding and host comparison policy are consequential security choices. Split the frozen cookie grammar profile to Sol medium.

units.label: I02
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Implement a frozen strict-hex/base64 policy; review stored compatibility and token hashes independently. Unresolved migration returns to I01.

units.label: I03
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Implement qualified host primitives; independently review actual host/timing guarantees, mismatched lengths and surrounding error policy.

units.label: I04
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Frozen cookie adapter is bounded; review malformed first duplicates, Domain refusal and login/logout defaults through real callers. Astra only for evidenced security conflict.

units.label: C01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Grammar/error precedence, full row count and interfaces/UI ownership need a contract decision; prepared corpora are mechanical.

units.label: C02
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Shared grammar and wrapper implementation follow frozen corpus and ownership. Raise to high for unresolved export/initialization closure.

units.label: C03
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Authoritative review-to-commit, consent/digests, stale/deny/replay and resource/error order warrant focused independent authority review.

units.label: C04
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Conditional serializer evaluation is finite, not automatic adoption. Sol high review only if privacy/file projection or formula protection changes.

units.label: H01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Winning abort reason, streamed body, full-body deadline and reader cleanup are lifecycle races. Prepared race fixtures can be cheaper.

units.label: H02
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Conditional quota correction must preserve per-hop policy and deadline/error order. A bounded violation reproduction alone fits Sol medium.

units.label: E01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: One material semantic comparison at a time; retain-now bookkeeping is cheap. No ten mandatory spikes. Astra only for a specific consequential unresolved decision.

units.label: R01
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Match the actual released risk: Sol medium for isolated N02/N04/C02; Sol high for joins; Astra medium D04/C03 and Astra high I01/I03 critical review.

units.label: R02
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Codex performs Git. Cheap cleanup follows accepted caller-switch evidence; substantive retirement/shared glue joins need Sol high. No blanket TS deletion.

units.label: R03
units.rationale_and_decomposition: Coordinate selected qualification with Sol high; use a finite independent combined-invariant review for authority, installed/native/Wasm claims, budgets and rollback.

steps.delegation_reminder: Use Luna low for inventory/crosswalk extraction and Sol medium for P01/P02 interpretation; use Sol high only for an actual source/evidence contradiction.
Use Sol high for the full N01/D01 oracle and compatibility contracts. Use Luna low/medium for specified extraction and seeded fixtures after the contract is defined.
Use Luna low for packet records. Codex retains Git; finite technical readiness decisions stay Sol medium or high according to their unresolved seam.

Select each finite packet separately: N02 and released N03 leaf work use Sol medium; N04 mechanics use Sol low; prepared fixtures use Luna medium. Unfrozen contracts or assembly reconciliation use Sol high.
Use Sol medium for N02 and frozen N03 leaf adapters, Sol low for N04 mechanics, and Sol medium for their isolated error/caller review. Full N03 harness/registration reconciliation uses Sol high.
Use Sol high for full N05/N06 producer, ABI and assembly joins. A fixed individual consumer check can use Sol medium; routine receipt indexing uses Luna low.
Use Sol high for full D02/D03 compatibility and integration packets; a strictly frozen pure adapter can use Sol medium. Prepared corpus generation uses Luna medium.
Use Sol high for D04 composition and host joins, with a short Astra medium independent critical diagnostic review. Astra high is reserved for an evidenced new major seam decision.
Use Sol high for full backend/installed qualification and risk-matched independent review; use Luna low/medium for exact-source receipt bookkeeping.

Follow the family allocation: I01 persisted-security policy uses Astra high; I02/I04 frozen adapters use Sol medium; I03 uses Sol high with Astra high timing-guarantee review; C01/C03 and H01/H02 full joins use Sol high. C02/C04 bounded work uses Sol medium and prepared fixtures use Luna medium. Conditional tasks remain conditional.
Use Luna low/medium or Sol low for accepted mechanical cleanup; Sol high for substantive backend-retirement or one material E01 semantic decision. Codex performs Git; do not repeat completed work.
Use Sol high for selected joined qualification and a finite Astra high independent critical review; Luna medium handles residual receipts. Review only the actually selected released scope.

selection_rule: Choose the least expensive supported combination likely to succeed over implementation, retries and review. Use the stronger known-risk choice upfront; no required cheap failed attempt. Lower a choice for an explicitly frozen narrower packet, and record the reason. Do not apply whole-unit high effort to routine fixture/index tasks.
future_evaluation: During authorized work record packet outcome, actual wall time, repairs/retries and available usage. Compare representative same-input tasks only when authorized and useful; no benchmark or paid implementation experiment is launched by this plan.
